_about: Written by tools/import_zone_kit.gd from data/source/heap_kit.csv and the art in G:/My Drive/Card Game Art/Approved_ZoneKits/VerdantDump: one entry per kit id with its lock, family (group / slot), prepared size, pivot (0..1 of the trimmed image), tile size in metres at 400 px/m, sheet parts. EnvKit reads it: every id here resolves like an Environment Kit id (assets/art/zone_kits/heap/<ID>.webp). Hand-added keys (height, width, tile, placeholder, slot) survive a re-import; entries not on the sheet (aliases) are kept.

DUMP-BD-JUNK.desc: Distant mossy junk hills in haze along the bottom, transparent sky.

DUMP-BD-ROTHEART.desc: Distant giant tree. Wide, soft, no hard horizon objects in the middle. Palette #7C8F45, #B5552D, #E3A857, #5C6B5E, #8B6D4C. Mood: scrappy, hopeful, nature reclaiming junk. Building language: Patched shacks of scrap metal and old doors, overgrown with moss and vines, rusty windmills. Painted, not pixel: clean bold shapes, soft cel-shaded painting, rich harmonious colour, matching PAINTOVER-TOWN.png. No text or letters.

DUMP-HERO-JUNK-MOUNTAIN.desc: A towering mound of doors, wheels, tins and crates overgrown with flowers, a plank stair zig-zagging to a lantern-lit shack with a little windmill on the summit.

DUMP-HERO-ROTHEART.desc: The main-dungeon goal: a castle-scale knot of twisting roots and swallowed scrap, a heart-shaped hollow with a violet glow, mutated fungi climbing it, hanging moss, roots spilling outward across the ground. Awe-inspiring and sad: it was once beautiful.

DUMP-HERO-SCRAPMORE.desc: The walkable junk hill of the junk peaks: a rounded mound of doors, tyres and crates under grass and flowers, a slide chute of tin down one side, a sprout mound at its foot; 3/4 view, about 12 m tall, a 1.7 m person for scale.

DUMP-HERO-WINDMILL.desc: A patched windmill of tin and planks with four patchwork cloth sails, flower boxes, an awning porch and a violet root creeping up one side.
